unresolved.reason: Guyana's dated Foreign Ministry schedule limits Uruguay's exemption to diplomatic or official passports, while the live ISS and Trinidad mission schedules expressly include ordinary passports for 90 days. No current Uruguayan passport-authority guidance directly resolves the inconsistent Guyanese ordinary-passport rule, so the visa-free fallback is not promoted.

Guyana's dated Foreign Ministry schedule limits Indonesia's exemption to diplomatic, official or service passports, while the live ISS and Trinidad mission schedules list Indonesia for 30 days without that restriction. No current Indonesian passport-authority guidance directly resolves the inconsistent Guyanese ordinary-passport rule, so the visa-free fallback is not promoted.

Guyana's dated Foreign Ministry and live Trinidad mission schedules limit Cuba's exemption to diplomatic, official or service passports, while the live ISS schedule lists Cuba without that restriction. No current Cuban passport-authority guidance directly resolves the inconsistent Guyanese ordinary-passport rule, so the visa-free fallback is not promoted.
